# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the Kent Beck-style RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle: RED → GREEN (with retry) → REFACTOR |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD cycles; delegates code generation to WorkerAgent and execution to PodmanOrchestrator |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Standalone LLM code-generation component; builds prompts and returns code strings for each TDD phase |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment by asking the LLM what test to write next |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer for the Clean Room harness; sends code pulses to the container |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman; manages container lifecycle and file pulses |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook operations: creation, updates, merging, and retrieval of knowledge bullets |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments; stores to PostgreSQL with SQLite fallback |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes generator performance and extracts learning insights from task outcomes |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into actionable playbook updates (delta bullets) |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation with bullet retrieval |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval system for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| BulletClusterer | src/playbook/clustering.py | DBSCAN-based clustering for playbook bullets |
| BulletDeduplicator | src/playbook/deduplication.py | Handles semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks with provenance-aware filtering |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Checks code for forbidden imports and blocked builtins |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST context maps from source files for code generation context |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec objects |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before the RED phase |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records TDD failures and interventions for self-improvement |
| TDDLessonInjector | src/agents/tdd_lesson_injector.py | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts based on development phase |
| LessonExtractor | src/agents/tdd_lessons.py | Extracts TDD lessons from resolved beads issues |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Anonymous agent capability tracking |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator.py | Measures experiment success rates across the system |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency.py | Computes token efficiency scores from LanguagePod run data |
| PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer | src/reliability/playbook_analyzer.py | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN outcomes |
| TDDCycleAnalyzer | src/reliability/tdd_cycle_analyzer.py | Measures first-pass GREEN rate and trend over time |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for all code generation activities |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³: Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason retriever |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle_number)
    Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement (spec)

    loop for each cycle (max MAX_ITERATIONS)
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec, existing_code)
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        Pod->>ImportFilter: check(test_code)
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: code})
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult (passed=False)
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod

        alt RED aborted (security failure)
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
        else RED passed
            loop up to max_green_attempts
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                Pod->>ImportFilter: check(impl_code)
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                deactivate Pod
                alt GREEN passed or abort
                    break
                else
                    Cycle->>Cycle: set error_feedback from output
                end
            end

            alt GREEN failed
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
            else GREEN passed
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
                deactivate Pod

                opt Learning loop (if reflector + curator configured)
                    Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                    Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                    Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                    Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput (delta_bullets)
                    Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                    Playbook-->>Cycle: added_bullets
                end

                Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=True)
            end
        end
        deactivate Cycle

        Runner->>Runner: check if planner says COMPLETE
        alt COMPLETE
            break
        end
    end

    Runner-->>Runner: return IterativeResult
```
